definition: [ תַּחֲנָה ] noun feminine encamping, or encampment ; — plural suffix תַּחֲנֹתִי (si vera 1.) אֶלמְֿקוֺם פְּנִֹי אַלְמֹנִי 2Kgs 6:8 , unto such and such a place is my encamping ; but form very strange. Read probably תֵּחָֽבְאוּ ye shall hide yourselves , so ᵑ6 Th Klo .
